messages.content: Sunday is confirmed. My wife has to be back in Atlanta for something Monday morning, so let's return Sunday evening. Please recheck the Friday flights for two people and make the hotel just Friday and Saturday nights.

I found two practical nonstop round trips from Atlanta to Raleigh-Durham. Delta leaves Friday, November 14 at 6:25 p.m. and arrives at 7:52 p.m.; the Sunday flight leaves Raleigh-Durham at 7:10 p.m. and reaches Atlanta at 8:43 p.m. Main Cabin is $486 total for two. Southwest leaves Friday at 7:05 p.m. and arrives at 8:28 p.m.; its Sunday return departs at 6:35 p.m. and arrives at 8:05 p.m. Wanna Get Away Plus is $452 total for two. Both fares include standard seat selection within their respective boarding or seating systems, and neither itinerary has a connection.
The Delta return gives us a little more family time Sunday. Is the Friday flight late enough that we can get to the airport after work without rushing too badly?

The 6:25 p.m. departure is the latest nonstop Delta option that still arrives before 8:00 p.m. There is also an 8:10 p.m. Delta flight arriving at 9:37 p.m. at the same total fare. The later one provides more margin after work, but it would push hotel arrival close to 10:30 p.m. after collecting bags and driving into Raleigh.
Keep the 6:25. We'll plan around it. What are the two-night hotel totals now? One room for both of us, checking out Sunday.

For Friday, November 14 through Sunday, November 16, the Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Downtown has one king room at $378 total, including taxes, with free cancellation until 11:59 p.m. on November 12. The Casso Raleigh has a king room at $406 total, including taxes, cancellable until 6:00 p.m. on November 13. Both reservations allow two adults and show no mandatory property fee.
Use the Hampton. Before you book, give me the full combined amount for the Delta flights and that room.

The Delta Main Cabin round trip is $486 for two travelers, and the Hampton king room is $378 for two nights. The combined trip total is $864. That excludes optional checked-bag charges, airport parking, and any incidental deposit collected by the hotel.
Good. Are there two seats together on both flights without paying extra?
Yes. On the Friday flight, 18A and 18B are available together. On the Sunday return, 20A and 20B are available together. They are standard Main Cabin seats with no added seat charge.
Take those seats. Please book the flights for both of us and the Hampton room under my name, with my wife listed as the second guest.

I have the Delta itinerary and Hampton room ready to purchase using the traveler names and payment details already on file. One final check: Friday, November 14 at 6:25 p.m. from Atlanta to Raleigh-Durham, returning Sunday, November 16 at 7:10 p.m.; seats 18A/18B outbound and 20A/20B inbound; one king room for two nights. The amount due now is $864. Shall I submit both bookings?

Both bookings are confirmed. The Delta flights for Avery Thompson and her wife depart Atlanta at 6:25 p.m. Friday, November 14 and return from Raleigh-Durham at 7:10 p.m. Sunday, November 16. Seats are 18A and 18B outbound, then 20A and 20B on the return. Airfare charged was $486 total. The Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh Downtown is confirmed for one king room, checking in Friday and checking out Sunday, with Avery as primary guest and her wife as the second occupant. The hotel total is $378, and cancellation remains free through 11:59 p.m. on November 12. The combined confirmed total is $864.
